text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ugh, seriously, what is it now?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you've got business, spit it out 
already! You've been acting like that all 
day long!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Shut up! What else could I do? I've got my 
own circumstances... or rather, timing to 
worry about!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? That makes zero sense! If you 
don't need anything, stop following me 
around!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd bother coming over to your place 
if I didn't have business with ya!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me?! Then stop moping around and 
just tell me what you need already!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If it's a fight you want, I'll give you 
one! Come on, spit it out already!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? How dare you—... Wait, huh? 
Birth... day? What?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ah—! That's it for business, all done!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...... Hmph. What's with that? Don't be 
ridiculous. You could have just told me 
normally.
